name: kubescape
description: Kubescape is an open-source Kubernetes security platform for your IDE, CI/CD pipelines, and clusters. It includes risk analysis, security, compliance, and misconfiguration scanning, saving Kubernetes users and administrators precious time, effort, and resources.

issues.title: Signed, verifiable attestations for scan results
failed to get cloud data. resourceKind: ClusterDescribe; error: failed to get region on EKS
bug: SecurityException resources[].apiGroup is silently unmatchable (upstream armoapi-go DigestAttributesDesignator has no case for it)
CI: run govulncheck on kubescape's own dependencies (v4.0.15 ships 7 reachable known vulnerabilities)
LFX - Posture scanning + admission for agent-runtime CRDs (Agent Sandbox/Substrate), plus gVisor runtime-visibility gap
CEL rule engine support (evaluate ValidatingAdmissionPolicy rules alongside OPA/Rego)
Introduce a Limit on Concurrent Pull Requests to Optimize CI Usage

discussions.title: Can kubelet and API server related controls be excepted?
Rego eval conflict error on control C-0021 (exposed-sensitive-interfaces-v1)
Support Multiple Output Formats in a Single Scan
CLI scan shows "Action Required" for operator-only controls even when operator is installed, can CLI leverage operator data?
Readiness-aware learning and pre-readiness enforcement for zero-exposure security
